about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A passionate developer with a love for clean architecture
about.bio1: I'm a Software Architect based in Norway with over 6 years of professional experience building enterprise-grade systems. I design and develop fullstack solutions — from mobile apps and web frontends to backend microservices and infrastructure automation.
about.bio2: Currently working at Hansen Technologies, where I architect and maintain large-scale billing and CRM systems. I specialize in building offline-first applications, distributed systems, and developer tooling that makes teams more productive.
about.bio3: When I'm not coding, I'm probably exploring new technologies, contributing to open source, or hitting the gym. I believe in owning your data, writing clean code, and building software that respects its users.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Selected projects I've designed and built

sethabit.title: SetHabit
sethabit.description: Offline-first fitness tracker with full data ownership. Cross-platform mobile app with custom sync engine, habit tracking, workout logging, and progress analytics.

sysopoly-infra.title: Sysopoly Infrastructure
sysopoly-infra.description: Infrastructure-as-Code platform managing containerized microservices. Automated deployment, encrypted secrets management, and monitoring — all self-hosted on a VPS.

auth-service.title: OAuth2 Auth Service
auth-service.description: Custom-built authentication microservice with OAuth2 PKCE flow, JWT token management, refresh rotation, and multi-provider support (Google, Apple).

melhus.title: Sommer i Melhus
melhus.description: Event browsing app for summer activities in Melhus, Norway. Built as freelance work with bilingual support, calendar view, and search filtering.

deploy-webhook.title: Deploy Webhook Service
deploy-webhook.description: Automated deployment pipeline triggered by container registry webhooks. Validates signatures, pulls images, and restarts services with zero downtime.

homepage.title: This Website
homepage.description: My personal portfolio built with React 19, TypeScript, and CSS Modules. Features dark mode, i18n support, and a clean component architecture.
